author: Subscriptor
body:
My tournament map: Epsilon.



Map Name: Epsilon

Gamemode: DTM- Destroy the Monument (TOURNEY)

Creators: MapDev / ElectraXdroid

Helpers: Tynvale, Lokigh

Contributors: TheQunox_, Velenoso

Images: Click here

There is no download link because this is a tournament map and download links will aren't published in tournament maps.

This is a tournament map, which means it's 10v10. Teams are Orange and Purple. This map futures some cool stuff for the gameplay:

-Wide frontlines
-12 Diamond blocks- 4 for each side and 4 in the middle.
-Good sized void gap, designed for tournament.
-A big map
-3 Monuments: 1 Monument on the front tower, pretty easy to get, and tho monuments that are harder to get at the back inside the trees, in diagonal of the map which is harder to get.
-2 Big iron mines for each side.
-Soulsand & Cobweb holes on the map
-Sugar Cane & Water & Soulsand walls in the frontlines and near the Tower Monument.
-Spawn covered with leaves to prevent spawn shooting.
-Middle island which is important to control
-A beacon in the middle island
-The 2 back monuments are in different heights of the map which is gameplay-wised and will make the gameplay better.
-Map has elevations, so it isn't flat.

The map is also very aestheticly designed and looks good, and I hope it will have a good gameplay.

Feedback will be great.
